title: soroseris hookeriana subsp. hirsuta
intro: Soroseris hookeriana subsp. hirsuta, commonly known as the Himalayan wormwood, is a plant species native to the Himalayan region. It is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions such as fever, cough, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Soroseris hookeriana subsp. hirsuta include analgesic, anti-diarrheal, and anti-emetic effects, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
